summary: Per-dimension: correctness PASS; style PASS with one doc-drift note; security PASS; test_coverage PASS with one minor gap; performance PASS; error_handling PASS. All four Round 2 code items are materially addressed: the `e_eff = 4q/3 - 8q^2/9` derivation is correct and exact for the current `bb84_channel` calibration, `build_mdi_physical_protocol()` is correctly wired to the executed-state extractor through `_conditional_alice_bob`, both new functions validate inputs, and `build_mdi_bell_protocol()` now states the real remaining blocker in `scope_reason`. I also verified the mapping directly in Python at six `q` values, ran `tests/test_protocols/test_mdi_bell.py` successfully (`28 passed`), and `pytest --collect-only` reports `286` collected tests, which is consistent with the user’s `276` executed-test count if skips are excluded. No new major issues found.
